english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the quality of being important or significant.
This is the all-purpose noun for the importance of something.
Use this for the relative importance of a person, thing, or issue.
Use this when priority refers specifically to an item's relative importance, especially in expressions such as 'high priority'.
Use this noun when matter means the degree to which something is important.
Use 重要性 when stating the abstract importance of something instead of the more figurative 份量.
Use this when consideration means importance or the degree of attention something deserves.

examples.traditional: 大家都明白教育嘅重要性。
